description: Check the UTM tracking parameters on a campaign link before it goes out. Send the full link (http or https). Get back every utm_ parameter found, and a list of findings: a missing or empty utm_source, utm_medium or utm_campaign, upper-case letters in a value (analytics reports treat 'Email' and 'email' as two different values), spaces (a raw space, or a space written as %20 or +), a parameter name that is not lower case, a repeated parameter, a utm_ name that is not a standard one (a likely typo), and UTM parameters placed after the # sign. Each finding says which parameter and what to change. Nothing is fetched: the link is only read. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/url-utm-check). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

url.description: The full campaign link, starting http:// or https:// (up to 2,000 characters). It is read, never opened. Links with an email address or a password in them are refused.
